packageRules.description: ISC ships development releases on odd minor versions
paperless-ngx's gotenberg-client 1.x only speaks the Gotenberg 8 API, so flag the major in the PR title until paperless supports Gotenberg 9
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Do not merge until paperless-ngx supports Gotenberg 9.** paperless-ngx 3.4.2 ships gotenberg-client 1.x, which targets the Gotenberg 8 API: Gotenberg 9 removed `/forms/pdfengines/merge` (email ingestion returns 404) and renamed the LibreOffice `pdfa` field (office document conversion returns 400).
